title: Rate Card Footnote — Per-Point Fee Bands on an Amended Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# Per-Point Fee Bands

Footnote to the rate card of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions fixing the per-point fee carried for each point a subscription covers after an amendment of its coverage. The lower band edge is 20 points and the upper band edge is 60 points; the middle band step is 6 percent and the upper band step is 11 percent.

## Footnote

For an amendment the portfolio band is read from the points this subscription covers after it, because the amended coverage is priced on its own building's metering. Where the points the subscription covers after the amendment fall at or below the lower portfolio band, the per-point fee is the tier's annual fee per included meter. Where they stand above the lower band and at or below the upper band, the per-point fee is that fee less the middle band step. Where they stand above the upper band, the per-point fee is that fee less the upper band step.

## Band table

| Points the subscription covers after the amendment | Per-point fee |
|---|---|
| 20 or fewer | the tier's annual fee per included meter |
| 21 through 60 | that fee less 6 percent |
| 61 or more | that fee less 11 percent |

The points counted are the metered points that posted a reading in the month ending on the day of the amendment, one reading to a point.

## Boundaries (hypothetical, tier fee USD 165 per meter a year)

| Points covered | Per-point fee |
|---|---|
| 20 | USD 165.00 |
| 21 | USD 155.10 |
| 60 | USD 155.10 |
| 61 | USD 146.85 |
